en: No oil in the lock
note: claim short label; evidence E01 文件筒; issue 法

note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E01 文件筒; issue 法

note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E01 文件筒; issue 法

en: Clock restarted when the lights died
note: claim short label; evidence E02 座鐘; issue 機

en: The study clock had stopped at twenty to ten. It started ticking again during those three dark minutes, because someone in the study bumped the mantelpiece.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E02 座鐘; issue 機

en: The clock restarted on its own
note: claim short label; evidence E02 座鐘; issue 機

en: An old clock left stopped will start swinging at the slightest tremor. It's over an hour slow. Nothing to do with the lights.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E02 座鐘; issue 機

en: Twenty to ten, he called for you
note: claim short label; evidence E02 座鐘; issue 機

zh-TW: 這座鐘停在九點四十分，海德先生嚥氣的那一刻。那時候他一直在叫一個人的名字——塞德里克先生，你在哪裡？
en: This clock stopped at twenty to ten, the moment Mr Hyde breathed his last. Until then he kept calling one name. Mr Cedric, where were you?
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E02 座鐘; issue 機

en: Wake candle wax on the cloth
note: claim short label; evidence E03 黑布; issue 機

en: On the black cloth from the study mirror there's a drop of white wax, still soft. Wake candle wax. And the candlestick by the chair nearest the corridor is empty. When the lights went out, someone took a candle from that seat into the study.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E03 黑布; issue 機

en: No one dared cover the mirror
note: claim short label; evidence E03 黑布; issue 機

zh-TW: 黑布是被碰掉的，可是沒有人把它蓋回去。在守靈夜讓鏡子就這樣敞著——那個人，連回頭看一眼都不敢。
en: The cloth was knocked off, and nobody put it back. A mirror left bare on a wake night! Whoever did it didn't dare so much as look back.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E03 黑布; issue 機

en: Someone turned the valve down
note: claim short label; evidence E04 總閥; issue 機

zh-TW: 總閥上有新鮮的扳動痕跡。燈不是自己暗的，是有人在地下室把它關小了。
en: The main valve has fresh turn marks. The lights didn't dim on their own. Someone in the basement turned it down.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E04 總閥; issue 機

en: Study soot on the valve wheel
note: claim short label; evidence E04 總閥; issue 機

en: The soot on that valve wheel came from the study fireplace. Whoever dimmed the lights went to the study first, then back down to turn them up again. He never left the house.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E04 總閥; issue 機

en: Only Martha in the kitchen
note: claim short label; evidence E04 總閥; issue 機

zh-TW: 燈滅的時候，後門一直關著，地下室的廚房裡只有瑪莎一個人——沒有人從後門跑出去。
en: When the lights went out, the back door stayed shut and Martha was alone in the basement kitchen. No one ran out the back.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E04 總閥; issue 機

en: Every skeleton key is oiled
note: claim short label; evidence E05 萬用鑰匙; issue 法

en: Every one of Briggs's skeleton keys is oiled. Without oil, they won't turn.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E05 萬用鑰匙; issue 法

en: Skeleton keys can't open the tube
note: claim short label; evidence E05 萬用鑰匙; issue 法

en: Skeleton keys off a ring like that struggle with an ordinary door, let alone a brass tube.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E05 萬用鑰匙; issue 法

note: claim short label; evidence E06 工作單; issue 法

en: The work order says: new spring fitted, opened three times in the owner's presence, repaired. The lock was mended, with no back door left in it.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E06 工作單; issue 法

en: Locksmith left in the evening
note: claim short label; evidence E06 工作單; issue 機

zh-TW: 工作單寫著五點收工。布里格斯傍晚就走了，守靈夜根本不在屋裡——他跟這件事毫無關係。
en: The work order says he finished at five. Briggs left in the evening and wasn't in the house on wake night at all. He has nothing to do with this.
note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E06 工作單; issue 機

en: Work order only says "tested"
note: claim short label; evidence E06 工作單; issue 法

zh-TW: 工作單上寫的是『校試』，不是『修理』——布里格斯根本沒動過那個筒子的鎖芯。

note: claim spoken line (Sherefox); evidence E06 工作單; issue 法

en: Locksmith met Martha in the kitchen
note: claim short label; evidence E07 手帕; issue 機

en: This handkerchief was behind the kitchen stove. It smells of machine oil and bears Martha the cook's initial. Briggs slipped back at night to see her. When the lights went out, he was in the kitchen by the back door, and nobody ran out the back.

en: Coffin and chairs
note: hotspot name; yields 案件筆記

zh-TW: 靈柩兩旁排著六張椅子。最靠近走廊的那一張，椅墊上還有一點凹陷，坐墊旁的小桌上放著一杯沒喝完的白蘭地，桌角的小燭台卻是空的——其他五張椅子旁的白蠟燭都還點著。
en: Six chairs line the coffin, three to a side. The one nearest the corridor still has a slight dent in its cushion. On the little table beside it sits an unfinished glass of brandy, but the small candlestick on the table's corner is empty. By the other five chairs, the white candles are still burning.
note: hotspot description shown when inspected

en: Irene
note: hotspot name; yields E_D01_11 艾琳的證詞

zh-TW: 年輕的女僕抱著托盤，手還在發抖。「燈滅之前，塞德里克少爺坐的那張椅子就已經空了。燈亮的時候，他站在走廊口。他戴著黑手套——本來就是黑的，可是指尖亮亮的，像沾了灰。」
en: The young maid clutches a tray, her hands still trembling. "Before the lights went out, Master Cedric's chair was already empty. When they came back, he was standing at the end of the corridor. He wears black gloves, they're black anyway, but the fingertips were shiny, like they'd got dust on them."
note: hotspot description shown when inspected

en: Cedric
note: hotspot name; yields PN_D01_1 護身符

zh-TW: 塞德里克站在窗邊，背對著靈柩。他的懷錶鏈上掛著三個小墜子：一個小馬蹄鐵、一顆藍色的眼珠玻璃、一枚聖克里斯多福徽章。他對海德太太說：「嬸嬸，這些規矩都是鄉下人的把戲。」
en: Cedric stands by the window, his back to the coffin. Three little charms hang from his watch chain: a tiny horseshoe, a blue glass eye bead and a St Christopher medal. He says to Mrs Hyde, "Aunt, these customs are nothing but bumpkin tricks."
note: hotspot description shown when inspected

en: Memorial photograph
note: hotspot name; yields PN_D01_3（前半）

zh-TW: 靈堂正中掛著昨天拍的遺體照，全家人圍著亡者。塞德里克站在最邊上，臉別了過去，只拍到半張側臉。
en: In the middle of the parlour hangs yesterday's memorial photograph, the whole family gathered round the deceased. Cedric stands at the very edge, face turned away; the camera caught only half his profile.
note: hotspot description shown when inspected

en: Mrs Hyde
note: hotspot name; yields PN_D01_3（後半）、OBS_D01_01

zh-TW: 「老爺走的那晚，一直叫塞德里克的名字。我派人去找，他沒有回來。」她摸著胸前的髮辮胸針：「這是老爺用自己的頭髮給我編的，世上只有這一枚。」
en: "The night my husband died, he kept calling Cedric's name. I sent for him, but he never came." She touches the hair brooch at her breast. "My husband wove this for me from his own hair. There is only one in all the world."
note: hotspot description shown when inspected

en: The blotter bears a few lines of reversed writing. Held up to a mirror (Sherefox turns aside from the glass and uses a small hand mirror), it reads: "...half of my estate I bequeath to..." The name has been lost in a smudge of ink.

en: Martha the cook
note: hotspot name; yields 案件筆記

zh-TW: 瑪莎一直在擦同一個盤子。「我、我整晚都在廚房，後門？後門一直關著，沒人進出……真的沒有。」她說「沒人」的時候，眼睛飄向後門的掛鉤，那裡掛著一頂男用帽子。
en: Martha keeps wiping the same plate. "I-I was in the kitchen all night. The back door? The back door stayed shut, nobody came in or out... truly, nobody." As she says "nobody", her eyes drift to the hook by the back door, where a man's hat is hanging.

en: Briggs sits on the bench in the entrance hall, a constable watching him. "I swear I never touched that codicil. Last night I... last night I come on a private matter. I can't say what. If I did, someone'd get hurt."
